Name: Drivers License ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the driver license record. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Legislation Code
Description: The driver's license legislation code.

Name: License Number
Description: The driver's license number.

Name: License Type
Description: The type of license.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person to whom this driver's license belongs.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person to whom this driver's license belongs.

Name: From Date
Description: The start date of the driver's license.

Name: Issuing Authority
Description: The issuing authority.

Name: Issuing Country
Description: The name or code of the country of the public agency that has provided the person's driver's license.

Name: Issuing Location
Description: The issuing location.

Name: License Suspended
Description: Indicates whether the driver's license is suspended.

Name: Number Of Points
Description: The number of penalty points on the license.

Name: Suspended From Date
Description: The start date of any suspension period.

Name: Suspended To Date
Description: The end date of any suspension period.

Name: To Date
Description: The end date of the driver's license.

Name: Violations
Description: The number of violations on the license.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
